items.change: Added null-rendering default.tsx files for all parallel route slots.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 requires default components for unmatched parallel route slots.
items.required_rule: S: parallel route slots need default.js; builds fail without

items.change: Changed dynamic route host parameter types from number to string and widened related cached-fetch parameters to accept route strings.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 supplies dynamic route parameters as strings.
items.required_rule: D: commit lists it under 'Breaking changes addressed' (Next 16 route-type validation rejects number params)

items.change: Removed next/font/google Inter usage and changed the body class to font-sans.
items.responds_to: The new build needed to avoid Google Font fetching and use a network-independent system font.
items.required_rule: D: choice for network-independent builds; next/font/google still works in 16

items.change: Changed revalidateTag to await revalidateTag(CLICKHOUSE_CACHE_TAG, { expire: 0 }).
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 requires a cache-life profile as the second revalidateTag argument.
items.required_rule: S: single-argument revalidateTag is a TypeScript error in 16

items.change: Made OpenNext Cloudflare development initialization conditional on ENABLE_CLOUDFLARE=true and loaded it dynamically.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16/Turbopack builds should not initialize the Cloudflare development integration unless explicitly enabled.
items.required_rule: D: dev-only Cloudflare init made opt-in; no Next 16 failure shown

items.change: Added an empty top-level turbopack configuration to next.config.ts.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 builds with Turbopack by default and errors when a webpack config exists without a turbopack config.
items.required_rule: S: Turbopack is the default for next build and fails with a webpack config and no turbopack config; this project has a webpack() config

items.change: Replaced the ESLint/Prettier setup with Biome, added Biome lint/format/check scripts, removed the ESLint and Prettier configuration files and dependencies, and applied the resulting lint fixes.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 removed the next lint workflow, so project linting and formatting were moved to Biome.
items.required_rule: S: next lint removed and the lint script used it; the maintainers' replacement (Biome) is the chosen fix

items.responds_to: Cypress failed with webpackModule.init is not a function because its component runner depended on webpack internals changed by Next.js 16 Turbopack.
items.required_rule: D: commit says Cypress component tests are incompatible with Next 16 Turbopack

items.change: Removed the middleware that added x-url and x-pathname headers for prefetch requests.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 emitted a deprecation warning for this middleware usage, and the headers were no longer used.
items.required_rule: deprecation warning only (middleware still works); headers unused

items.change: Changed the production build and Cloudflare build instructions to use Webpack instead of Turbopack, while retaining Turbopack for development; documented the requirement.
items.responds_to: Turbopack was not supported by the Cloudflare Workers OpenNext deployment path.
items.required_rule: D: Turbopack (now default) not supported by the OpenNext Cloudflare build; build pinned to webpack

items.change: Removed the --webpack flag from the production build command.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 made Turbopack stable for production and the maintainers adopted it for faster builds.
items.required_rule: adopts Turbopack for production builds by choice

items.responds_to: Next.js 16 Turbopack option for using system TLS certificates.

items.change: Removed the eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds option from next.config.ts.
items.responds_to: Next.js 16 removed the eslint option from next.config along with next lint.
items.required_rule: S: the eslint config key is removed in 16 (NextConfig type error in a .ts config)
